title: Port the pstack principles laziness-protocol, minimize-reader-load, model-the-domain
action: For each slug, create skills/bee-principle-<slug>/SKILL.md from pstack principle-<slug>, in the exact shape of skills/bee-principle-subtract-before-you-add/SKILL.md (description 'Apply when ...', body, Check, Not when, Why, Depth). Put the depth into a new section of the expertise guide named in files whose craft it belongs to, and point Depth at that section. Add one row per slug to the '## Principle homes' section of docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md, in the existing row grammar: the guide anchor, a spoken line, a classes line naming the route classes it fires for (from the nine), then applied_at. Pick the classes from the pstack 'when it applies' line. No line names Cursor, Graphite, bugbot or poteto-agent; no hand-picked model or subagent_type; tools become bee counterparts per D2. Copy the pstack LICENSE verbatim to each new skill directory as LICENSE.pstack. Run bee dev regen and commit the rendered trees and the manifest with the cell. Write docs/history/pstack-playbook-port/port-notes/principles-ppb-27.md. Facts you need, so no lookup is required: an advisor or design runner goes out as `bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind advisor --role <role> --json`; a judge or reviewer as `--kind reviewer`; read-only gathers as `--kind gather`; the blind-lane roles are lane-1, lane-2 and lane-3, and `bee blind check` checks a blind brief; write these spellings into the skill text, never run them. Bee commands you may run in this cell: cargo test, `.bee/bin/bee dev regen`, `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check`, `.bee/bin/bee knowledge check`, and `bee herding notify`. Never run `bee dispatch` or any of its `--help`; the worker guard refuses it and the cell stops. A principle or skill that does not exist in skills/ yet keeps its method as a plain sentence and is named in the port notes.
